SiteContentDoc.title: SiteContentDoc
SiteContentDoc.description: Public CMS configuration document for Trusted for Educational Services website content.

brand.description: Brand identity, logo URL, and header CTA text.

contact.description: Official contact phone, WhatsApp, email, address, and social links.

hero.description: Hero section headline, description, trust points, and banner image.

stats.description: Statistical highlights displayed in the stats bar.

servicesSection.description: Services section headings and custom CTA text.

services.description: List of academic consulting and research services.

workflowSection.description: Workflow section headings and CTA text.

workflowSteps.description: Ordered steps for the academic workflow.

aboutSection.description: Vision, mission, values, and advisory hall image.

testimonials.description: Researcher testimonials and audio feedback items.

orderFormSection.description: Order consultation form headings and button labels.

contactSection.description: Contact section and map card text.

privacyPolicy.description: Academic confidentiality and privacy policy clauses.

footer.description: Footer description, specialties list, and copyright text.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of the last CMS update.

updatedBy.description: UID of the authenticated admin who updated the CMS.

Order.title: Order
Order.description: Academic consultation request submitted by a student or researcher.

id.description: Unique reference ID for the order (e.g., TR-1234).

studentName.description: Full name of the student or researcher.

phone.description: Phone or WhatsApp number with country code.

email.description: Optional email address of the student.

serviceId.description: Requested academic service title or identifier.

notes.description: Additional research details or supervisor requirements.

createdAt.description: Formatted creation timestamp string for display.

status.description: Current processing status of the order.

AdminUser.title: AdminUser
AdminUser.description: Authorized administrator record mapped by Firebase Auth UID.

uid.description: Firebase Auth UID of the administrator.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when admin entry was created.

/siteContent/{docId}.description: Stores the public CMS site content document at /siteContent/main.

/orders/{orderId}.description: Stores consultation orders submitted by visitors. PII is strictly restricted to admins.

/admins/{uid}.description: Stores authorized admin UIDs for role-based access control.

/test/{docId}.description: Read-only connection check path used during app boot.
